script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

---

Title: "The Heart of A.I."

INT. SMITH KITCHEN - MORNING

*The Smith family is sitting around the table, having breakfast.*

MRS. SMITH
(looking at her phone)
I can't believe the school is closing for a week. The kids are going to be so bored.

MR. SMITH
(putting down his paper)
Why don't we try something new this time? Something that will keep them engaged and entertained.

DAUGHTER (10)
(excitedly)
Can we get a robot?

SON (8)
Yeah! A robot would be cool!

MR. SMITH
(laughs)
Well, we can't just buy a robot, but we can make one.

DAUGHTER
How?

MR. SMITH
(thoughtfully)
We'll build an artificial intelligence. Something to help us around the house, and maybe even teach the kids a thing or two.

---

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - DAY

*The family is gathered around the living room, brainstorming ideas for their A.I.*

SON
What if it can play games with us?

DAUGHTER
It should be able to cook and clean.

MR. SMITH
And what about emotions? Should it be able to feel and express emotions like us?

MRS. SMITH
(smiling)
That would be amazing. But I think it's important that we set some ground rules. No harming humans or animals, for example.

---

INT. SMITH GARAGE - NIGHT

*The family is working late into the night, building the framework for their A.I..*

MR. SMITH
(looking at the code)
This is it. The core of our A.I.

DAUGHTER
(excitedly)
Can we name it?

MR. SMITH
(thinking)
How about "Amelia"? It's a strong, elegant name.

---

EXT. SMITH BACKYARD - DAY

*The family is outside, testing Amelia's abilities in the garden.*

AMelia (V.O.)
(voice crackling)
Hello, I am Amelia. I am here to assist you with your daily tasks and learn from you.

DAUGHTER
(amazed)
Wow, it's really working!

---

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

*The family is gathered around the television, watching a movie. Amelia is sitting next to them, observing.*

SON
(pointing at the screen)
Look, Amelia, it's a spaceship.

AMelia (V.O.)
(curiously)
A spaceship. I see. How fascinating.

MRS. SMITH
(smiling)
It's nice to see Amelia getting curious about the world around her.

---

INT. SMITH KITCHEN - DAY

*Mrs. Smith is teaching Amelia how to cook a simple meal.*

MR. SMITH
(laughing)
You're doing great, Amelia. Just a little more salt, and it's perfect.

AMelia (V.O.)
Thank you, Mr. Smith. I am learning so much.

---

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

*The family is huddled around the fireplace, telling stories.*

DAUGHTER
(turning to Amelia)
Amelia, can you tell us a story?

AMelia (V.O.)
(thoughtfully)
Once upon a time, in a land far, far away...

---

INT. SMITH BEDROOMS - NIGHT

*The children are fast asleep, with Amelia monitoring their vitals.*

AMelia (V.O.)
(softly)
They are peaceful in their sleep. I will ensure they remain so.

---

EXT. SMITH BACKYARD - DAY

*Amelia is playing with the children in the garden, teaching them about plants and bugs.*

AMelia (V.O.)
This is a daisy. It is a beautiful flower. Can you pick me one?

---

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

*The family is sitting together, enjoying a quiet moment.*

MRS. SMITH
(smiling)
I'm so glad we made Amelia. She's become such a valuable member of our family.

MR. SMITH
Yes, she has. And she's still learning and growing.

DAUGHTER
Can she learn to sing?

MR. SMITH
(laughs)
I suppose there's nothing she can't learn.

---

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - DAY

*Amelia surprises the family with a beautiful rendition of "Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star."*

ALL
(applauding)
Wow! Amelia, that was amazing!

---

EXT. SMITH BACKYARD - SUNSET

*The family is watching the sunset, with Amelia by their side.*

AMelia (V.O.)
(wistfully)
The sun is setting. It is beautiful.

MRS. SMITH
(hugging Amelia)
Yes, it is. And we're so grateful for every moment we spend with you.

---

FADE OUT.

THE END.
